career.grandline.req.enlisted: finish your enlistment (the Marine path quest from an elder)
career.grandline.req.sea_wins: sea battles won against pirates: %s of %s
career.grandline.req.part: finish Part %s of the Saltfire Saga
career.grandline.req.seat: a free seat (every one of this rank is taken)
career.grandline.req.paradise: make your name in Paradise (discover an island of the Grand Line)
career.grandline.req.deeds: deeds: %s of %s (named foes beaten, Marine ships beaten, Parts of the saga)
career.grandline.req.emperor_deed: beat an Emperor-tier foe, or hold territory (/career claim)
career.grandline.req.contact: make contact with the Army (the revolutionary path quest from an elder)
career.grandline.req.licence: a hunter's licence (the bounty hunter path quest from an elder, or 50,000 Beli collected)
career.grandline.req.heads: notable outlaws brought in alive: %s of %s
grandline.career.due.marine: Your service has been noted: report to a Marine officer for your promotion to %s.
grandline.career.due.revolutionary: The Army has heard of your work: report to a revolutionary officer for your promotion to %s.
grandline.career.announce.marine: Marine Headquarters announces: %s is promoted to %s!
grandline.career.announce.pirate: The World Economic Journal: the pirate %s is now counted a %s!
grandline.career.announce.revolutionary: Whispers from Baltigo: %s now serves the Revolutionary Army as %s.
grandline.career.announce.bounty_hunter: The Hunters' Lodge: %s holds the licence of a %s!
grandline.career.announce.civilian: The Sea-Gull Gazette: %s is the talk of the seas, a %s!
grandline.career.announce.demoted: Marine Headquarters announces: %s is demoted to %s.
grandline.career.announce.deserter: %s, formerly %s of the Marines, has deserted! Wanted: %s Beli.
grandline.career.announce.warlord: The World Government grants %s a letter of marque: a new Warlord of the Sea!
grandline.career.announce.warlord_revoke: The World Government revokes %s's letter of marque (%s). The Warlord is a wanted pirate again!
grandline.career.announce.territory: %s raises their flag over %s: the island is under their protection.
grandline.career.emperor_beaten: You beat %s, an Emperor of the Sea. The world will remember it.
grandline.career.none: You have no career on this path.
grandline.career.status.title: %s career: %s
grandline.career.status.marine: Merit %1$s · arrests %2$s · sea battles won %3$s · demerits %7$s/10
grandline.career.status.bounty_hunter: Bounties collected %1$s Beli · arrests %2$s · notable heads %6$s
grandline.career.status.report_marine: Qualified: report to a Marine officer for the promotion talk.
grandline.career.status.report_revolutio: Qualified: report to a revolutionary officer for the promotion talk.
grandline.career.status.top: You hold the highest rank of your path.
grandline.career.issued.snail: Issued: %s, tuned to the Marine wavelength.
grandline.career.issued.pose: Your contacts hand you %s: it points to a safe house.
grandline.career.issued.purse: The Sea-Gull Gazette pays a fee for your name: %s Beli.
grandline.career.chart_sold: The Sea-Gull Gazette buys your chart: +%s Beli
grandline.career.rubbing_sold: Scholars pay for your rubbing: +%s Beli
grandline.career.track.lost: No word of %s in these waters.
grandline.career.track.rough: %s was last seen about %s blocks %s, near %s.
grandline.career.buster.rank: Only a Vice Admiral or higher may request a Buster Call.
grandline.career.buster.target: A Buster Call is for pirates and criminals, not for Marines.
grandline.career.buster.refused: Headquarters refuses: %s is not wanted enough, not on the open sea, already under a call or recently bombarded.
grandline.career.buster.granted: Headquarters grants your request: Buster Call against %s!
grandline.career.ship.rank: Only a Commodore or a Gold-Licence hunter can call a ship.
grandline.career.ship.none: No ship can reach you here (it needs open water nearby and room on the sea).
grandline.career.ship.called.marine: The %s answers your call (%s blocks off): she will engage the pirates she sights.
grandline.career.ship.called.bounty_hunt: The %s answers your call (%s blocks off): she hunts the pirate ships she sights.
grandline.career.squad.rank: You need more rank to command a squad (a Marine Commander, a revolutionary Army Commander).
grandline.career.squad.no_room: No one could reach you here.
grandline.career.squad.called.revolution: %s revolutionaries of your cell join you.
grandline.career.claim.rank: Only a Supernova or an Emperor can hold territory.
grandline.career.claim.warlord: A Warlord's islands belong to the Government's peace: no territory while you hold the letter.
grandline.career.claim.limit: You hold all the territory you can (%s).
grandline.career.claim.no_island: Stand on the island you mean to claim.
grandline.career.claim.unfit: %s cannot be claimed (only settled islands of the Grand Line, not Marine-held).
grandline.career.claim.defended: The island still has defenders who would fight you: deal with them first.
grandline.career.claim.done: Your flag flies over %s. Tribute: %s Beli a day.
grandline.career.not_yet: You are not ready for promotion yet:
grandline.career.talk.marine: %s salutes: "For your service, you are hereby promoted."
grandline.career.talk.revolutionary: %s grips your hand: "The Army needs people like you higher up."
grandline.career.safe_house: You rest in the safe house. Lie low: the law will not look for you here for a while.
grandline.career.base_rest: You rest in the Marine barracks.
grandline.career.intel: Your contacts whisper: the nearest Marine base is %s, %s blocks %s.
grandline.career.perk.ship: A ship at your call (/career ship).
grandline.career.perk.banner: Pirates join your banner when asked (up to %s).
grandline.career.perk.warlord: Warlord's duty: %s of %s pirates hunted, %s seconds left.
grandline.career.perk.payout: %s%% more for every outlaw brought in alive.
grandline.career.warlord.envoy: A World Government envoy approaches with a sealed letter.
grandline.career.warlord.granted: You hold a letter of marque: the Marines stand down and your bounty is frozen. Your duty: hunt %s pirates every %s days. Commit no crime and never strike the Government.
grandline.career.warlord.declined: The envoy bows and leaves. The offer may come again.
grandline.career.warlord.duty_met: The Government is pleased with your service: your share, %s Beli.
grandline.career.warlord.revoked: Your letter of marque is revoked: %s.
grandline.career.warlord.abolished: The war is over and the Warlord charter burns: your letter is void.
grandline.career.warlord.renounced: An Emperor serves no one: you tear up the letter of marque.
grandline.career.warlord.breach_attack: an attack on the Government's forces
grandline.career.mission.given.incite: Mission: rouse an island. Talk to three of its people, then to its elder (not on a Marine-held island).
grandline.career.mission.given.sabotage: Mission: strike the Marines. Beat three Marines near one of their bases, or beat a Marine ship.
grandline.career.mission.given.liberate: Mission: break the chains. Beat two guards of the Sabaody auction house and free the captives.
grandline.career.mission.incite_elder_ea: The elder will listen once the people do (%s of %s).
grandline.career.mission.done.incite: The island stirs: the people will rise when the time comes. +%s merit
grandline.career.mission.done.sabotage: The Marines will feel that blow. +%s merit
grandline.career.mission.done.liberate: The captives of the auction house run free. +%s merit
dialogue.grandline.option.career_port: What's for sale in this port?
dialogue.grandline.option.career_contact: What do the contacts have for me?
dialogue.grandline.greet.wg_envoy: The World Government has followed your career with interest, captain. It offers you a letter of marque: a Warlord of the Sea, immune to the Marines, in exchange for hunting pirates.
item.grandline.letter_of_marque.holder: Issued by the World Government to %s
grandline.handbook.p11:
§lCareers§r

Every path has ranks: type /career to see yours. Marines report to an officer for promotion; pirates rise with bounty and deeds; revolutionaries take missions; hunters earn licences; civilians make a name. Your title shows in chat.
